description: Public accounts this workspace learns from, with when their numbers were last recorded (posts_at). needs_update marks the ones past their refresh: competitors_refresh reads Instagram, YouTube, Bluesky and Mastodon accounts; for other networks, competitor_posts_record takes the numbers their public profile shows. refresh_error says in one line why an account can't be read.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
